title: Outis Two-Layer JEV Decision Routing
one_liner: Separates zero-output-token Layer-1 relevance screening (noul, drop < 0.35 preserving ambiguity) from Layer-2 calibrated choice aggregation (pass floor 0.70, conflicts -> unknown).

key_claims.text: Ambiguous items between 0.35 and 0.70 survive routing so conflicting evidence is never silently discarded.
Direct conflicts force unknown/contested verdicts rather than smoothing contradictions into false consensus.
